sloka: सो ऽस्त्रयुक्तेन बाणेन नीलो वक्षसि ताडितः ।निर्दह्यमानः सहसा निपपात महीतले ।। ६.५९.९० ।।।।
transliteration: so 'strayuktena bāṇena nīlo vakṣasi tāḍitaḥ ।nirdahyamānaḥ sahasā nipapāta mahītale ।। 6.59.90 ।।।।

translations.english: Speaking like that, Ravana, the king of Rakshasas chanting the mantras and fixing the arrow struck the commander in chief (Neela) of the Vanara army.
